# Farhan Aslam

> Farhan Aslam (also known as Dev Farhan) is a freelance UI/UX designer and full-stack web developer based in Karachi, Pakistan. He has 4+ years of experience building conversion-focused websites for coaches, consultants, SaaS founders, startups, agencies and e-commerce brands in the UAE, Australia, the UK and the USA. Available for freelance projects and full-time remote roles.

## Key facts
- Role: UI/UX Designer & Full-Stack Web Developer
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan (works remotely)
- Experience: 4+ years
- Design tools: Figma, Adobe XD, Google Stitch, Framer
- Development: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Bootstrap, PHP, Laravel, Node.js
- Services: UI/UX design, frontend development, backend development, SEO optimization
- Response time: within 24 hours
- Contact: farhanaslam1992@gmail.com
